decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Heritage Statement Received: 23 December 2011 Internal Proposed Layout & Elevations - Drawing No: B764-NLPB-20082 Rev. B Received: 23 December 2011 Replacement Door Sets - Drawing No: 73524/19170G & 73524/19171G  Received: 28 February 2012 External cage installation surrounding emergency exit ladder to the rear of the building - Drawing No: P312722-HLPH-GEN-ASY-01A Received: 28 February 2012 Internal Lobby Cage - Drawing No: P312722-D08-ASY-01 Rev. C Received: 03 April 2012 Window Bar W14 Control Room Offices - Drawing No: P312722-01 Rev. C Received: 03 April 2012 Window Bar W13 Control Room Offices - Drawing No: P312722-02 Rev. C Received: 03 April 2012 Window Bar W12 Control Room Offices - Drawing No: P312722-03 Rev. C Received: 03 April 2012 Window Bar W10 & W11 Control Room Offices - Drawing No: P312722-04 Rev. C Received: 03 April 2012 Window Bar W8 & W9 Control Room Offices - Drawing No: P312722-05 Rev. C Received: 03 April 2012 Window Bar W20 High Lift Pump House - Drawing No: P312722-11 Rev. C Received: 03 April 2012  Window Bar W21 High Lift Pump House - Drawing No: P312722-12 Rev. B Received: 03 April 2012 Installation of 2no. antennae - Drawing No: B764-NLPB-20182 Rev. B Received: 03 April 2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal/external feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
description: Listed building works comprising:  External cage installation surrounding the emergency exit ladder at Lilleshall Engine House; Internal window bar sets to replace existing; Replacement door sets and locking mechanism; and internal security structure within the entrance lobby.
